pages.text: The dimension's underground biome, layered beneath the surface. It needs no torches: dense Lumen Crystal ore and tall, hanging glowvine light the dark, with $(l:lumenwater)Lumenwater$(/l) pools below.
It is also the most dangerous deep: the $(l:echo_sentinel)Echo Sentinel$(/l) drifts the caverns, and the buried halls of the $(l:vestige_cities)Vestige$(/l) ruins reach down into it.
